title: Animal Cell - Multicolor Educational Model (Remix)
author: antonijuvenikal
description:
A detailed, multicolor 3D printed cross-section of an animal cell, designed for educational use. This model was printed for a school biology project and features color-coded organelles for easy identification.

**Organelles represented include:**

- Nucleus (blue) with nucleolus (green)
- Mitochondria (green)
- Rough & Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum (orange/red)
- Golgi Apparatus (blue)
- Vacuoles (orange rings)
- Ribosomes (small orange dots)
- Cell membrane (red outer shell)
- Cytoplasm (yellow base)

**Print notes:** This was printed using a multicolor setup with color changes assigned per organelle for clarity. The model splits into two halves, making the interior fully visible.

**Attribution:** This is a remix of an original model on Printables. Original listing: https://www.printables.com/model/1122614-animal-cell-for-biology-class/files. The original listing appears to be unavailable as of March 2026. All credit for the base design goes to the original creator.
